mcp_tools.name: creative_ideation_session
mcp_tools.title: Creative ideation session
mcp_tools.description: Submits a creative-ideation session record (brief and preparation, capture and generation, divergence methods, idea pool, selection criteria, shortlist and outcome) and returns a deterministic SESSION_COMPLETE / SESSION_NOT_COMPLETE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed volume-vs-target, dedup-arithmetic, shortlist-within-pool and method-vocabulary checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared session record; it generates no ideas and judges none.

inputSchema.description: The ideation-session record manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

expect.notes: All boolean flags true, arithmetic consistent (12-2=10), methods valid, shortlist within unique pool.
